summary: Munder Difflin's only quantitative self-claims are a README 'token use fell about 37%' from a replay of 13 agents over a week (explicitly flagged as a replay, but no replay script or data is in the repo) and CHANGELOG perf notes (~350× faster warm usage reads, ~1s main-thread block per shell launch) with no method or data. One manual before/after micro-benchmark script exists (test/usage-cache-benchmark.manual.cjs) but its outputs are committed only as two mp4 screen recordings, not as numbers; the ~289 blog posts quote other vendors' benchmarks rather than measuring the product.
result_focus_note: manual classification of published_results: outcome = does the tool do its job; engineering = speed of the software itself
